text: Right. But there can be multiple agents generating props when in this method since the single file blocks parallel writes
resolution: Implemented the parallel-write structure the user pointed at: extracted the already-converted prop recipes out of worldGeometry into per-prop files under compile/propRecipes, leaving worldGeometry as the compiler/lowering caller. This reduces future collisions because prop-generation agents can work in distinct prop recipe files instead of editing one large geometry file for every authored shape.
